eyebrow: The Power BI Course · Chapter Five
subtitle: Lesson 40 · DAX Fundamentals

code:
-- inside a calculated column (row context):
RowValue = [Total Sales]
-- [Total Sales] is secretly CALCULATE(SUM(...))
caption: Referencing a measure in row context triggers it with no CALCULATE visible.

code:
Customer Segment =
IF(
  CALCULATE(
    SUM(Sales[Sales Amount]),
    ALLEXCEPT(Customer, Customer[CustomerKey])
  ) < 2500,
  "Low", "High"
)
caption: One customer row becomes one filter — CALCULATE makes the switch.
